definitions.未着手: known acceptance, verified no implementation work
definitions.実装中: partial implementation or known unfinished acceptance
definitions.実装済み・未検証: all declared implementation acceptance present, verification missing
definitions.隔離テスト合格: the declared offline/mock/isolation acceptance passed; not authentic production DB proof
definitions.実DB認可確認済み: declared authenticated actor/RLS tests passed in confirmed isolated real DB
definitions.統合確認済み: declared integrated scope passed at pinned source, residual release gates separately tracked
definitions.公開可能: all product mandatory gates evidenced; no publication operation is implied
definitions.UNKNOWN: implementation/status/acceptance evidence insufficient; never treated as not-started or complete

calculation.product_done: status is 公開可能 AND every mandatory release_gate true AND evidence exists
calculation.control_done: explicit audit/preparation deliverable is 統合確認済み or 公開可能 AND evidence exists
calculation.rate: 100 * done / frozen required catalogue size, rounded 2 decimals; no stage weighting
calculation.meaning: measured completion-evidence coverage for this v1 named scope; not an estimate of implementation volume or overall product readiness
calculation.unknown_rows: included as required named items, cannot earn completion evidence; separately counted
calculation.overall: UNKNOWN: authoritative exhaustive whole-project denominator and exclusive GTO completion evidence not established
calculation.gto: excluded from owned groups and never altered
calculation.scope_change: catalogue IDs/group/required set is frozen; new scope needs policy version and new baseline
